svg.title: ViT-Tiny architecture
svg.desc: ViT-Tiny: patch embedding, positional encoding, twelve transformer encoder blocks, CLS token extraction, and linear head.

g.text: Conv 16×16, stride 16 → 4 patches of dim 192 (for 32×32 input)
Prepend learnable CLS → 5 tokens × dim 192; add learnable pos emb
dim=192, heads=3, MLP ratio=4 — all tokens processed jointly
Take position 0 from sequence → vector of dim 192 + LayerNorm

svg.text: 5.7M params — 80.72% top-1 (lowest in benchmark). Self-attention is data-hungry; hurts under frozen linear probe on small datasets.
MHSA: Q=W_Q·x, K=W_K·x, V=W_V·x → softmax(QKᵀ / sqrt(d_k)) · V applied to all tokens simultaneously
